panel_A.population: All 485 LOL scenes with the five classical enhancement operators
panel_A.predictions: Stored scene-held-out NR-free predictions from nr_fuzzy_oof.csv; never use all-data fitted scores
panel_A.target: Negative LPIPS-Alex from the existing LOL pipeline
panel_A.selection: Compute each scene Spearman correlation across its five outputs; choose maximum, median (243rd of 485 ascending correlations), and minimum. For each target correlation, choose the smallest numeric scene ID among ties. Correlations within absolute 1e-12 count as tied.
panel_A.labels: Stored PSNR, LPIPS and held-out NR-free values beneath each enhanced output; 8 pt minimum
panel_A.preprocessing: Original LOL RGB, bilinear 256x256 pipeline; preserve stored PSNR uint8-output convention and LPIPS float-output convention, and record feature/prediction provenance.
panel_A.winner_marks: Thin blue inner frame for LPIPS minimum; thin orange outer frame for NR-free maximum. Mark all exactly tied best outputs (absolute 1e-12).
panel_A.missing_images: Stop or report missing files; do not substitute another scene.

panel_B.population: All 290 SQUARE-LOL scenes, ten outputs each
panel_B.predictions: Stored frozen LOL-trained NR-free predictions used for human comparison
panel_B.selection: Compute within-scene Spearman versus human scores. Take the median of the 290 scene correlations and select the closest scene; ties use smallest numeric scene ID (absolute 1e-12).
panel_B.order: Ten outputs ordered by descending human score; equal human scores use stable method-name order for display, with average ranks shown for both human and NR-free scores.
panel_B.layout: Two rows of five images, each labelled human rank and NR-free rank. Include only if Panel A plus Panel B and caption fit on one supplement page, without text below 8 pt or Panel A images below 55 pt width. Inclusion depends only on readable layout and file availability, not on the results.

distribution_note: The held-out CSV has LF line endings in this release; its CRLF normalization matches the original hash. Numeric content is unchanged.
